feedback: This candidate continues the cautious tuning trend by further lowering base_speed to 0.7 and switching the line loss strategy from 'last_direction' to 'search_left', aiming to actively steer right when the line is lost and improve recovery. This change is motivated by the persistent stalling on the slalom track seen in all previous candidates (Iterations 0-4) despite gradual reductions in base_speed and adjustments to PID gains. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged, consistent with prior stable designs. The controller keeps kp at 8, kd at 0.5, and ki at 2.0, values that have been beneficial in smoothing steering and correcting steady-state errors (Iteration 4). Depending on the next race results, if stalling persists, consider further lowering base_speed or switching line_loss to 'search_right' to explore alternative recovery directions. If steering oscillation remains high, reduce kd further or adjust sensor_weights to dampen overcorrection. If rms_error or line loss events remain elevated, increase ki further or refine sensor_weights. This candidate is a cautious refinement worth racing to gather telemetry for more targeted tuning.
requested_changes: controller.base_speed=0.6 if stalling persists on slalom track
controller.line_loss='search_right' if 'search_left' does not improve line recovery
controller.kd=0.3 if steering oscillation remains high
